gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Expressive and loud, Revalia sprawls its widely spaced letters with a loose, easy stride. And Noto Sans Arabic does the quieter job, keeping its small letters open and its x-height tall for text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Revalia's open-bottomed g gives it away at once. Its headline swagger is the draw, while Noto Sans Armenian stays approachable, with full, wide round letters that keep the text easy to follow.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan has curves that never quite close up. Shrink Revalia down and its wide, showy spacing loses its swagger, while a larger sans-serif body would crowd it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Loud meets tidy here. Revalia is happiest showing off with a tall band of wide-spaced letters, while Noto Sans Bamum quietly keeps its big open counters doing the plain sans work of reading.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-batak: Big, brash, and a bit stretched out. Revalia handles the shouting with its relaxed stride, but Noto Sans Batak is the one you lean on for text, with a towering x-height and open e.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Brash letters, spaced out and loose. Revalia grabs attention with that open-curled g, while Noto Sans Bengali, with capitals barely taller than lowercase, settles into the text with open, easy mouths.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-carian: Loud, loose, and a little theatrical. Revalia's wide-spaced letters take the spotlight up top, then Noto Sans Carian sits below with terminals held apart, like scissor blades, in tidy sans-serif text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian has a large x-height and curves that stop short. Revalia sits above it with a tall, bold band of widely spaced letters, so headings show off while the text underneath stays level-headed.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Showy up top, sturdy below. Revalia hangs its wide-spaced, bold letters above Noto Sans Deseret, whose open apertures and squat ascenders keep the sans-serif text clear underneath.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Revalia swaggers with a bold, open-tailed g and a relaxed, widely spaced stride. Noto Sans Devanagari repeats that g but in a compact skyline where capitals melt into lowercase, so extended reading feels low-key.
